objective.text: Reject unexpected nested array keys using the array rule's allowed-key list.

difficulty.rationale: Reject an unexpected capability flag at the input boundary.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A profile object may contain only name and timezone. Extra keys must produce validation errors, not be silently dropped. Which parent rule enforces this allowlist alongside child rules?

options.rationale: Nullable addresses nullability, not the keys of a supplied object.
options.misconception: Nullable addresses nullability, not the keys of a supplied object.

options.rationale: The plain array rule checks the value type but does not restrict its keys.
options.misconception: The plain array rule checks the value type but does not restrict its keys.

options.rationale: The array rule with named allowed keys rejects additional keys within profile.
This requires listed keys but does not reject additional ones.
